title: Sawe breaks two-hour barrier with 1:59:30 world record at London Marathon

story.W: Four women went out at 2:12 pace and three were together at halfway (1:06:12). The pace eased in the second half, and Tigst Assefa edged clear in the closing stages to win by 12 seconds. Three women broke 2:16 in one race for the first time.
story.M: Six men reached halfway together in 1:00:29. Sabastian Sawe and Yomif Kejelcha pulled clear between 30 and 35 km and kept accelerating; Sawe broke away with a mile to go and became the first man to run an official marathon under two hours. The first three all beat the previous world record.

performances.name: Sabastian Kimaru SAWE
performances.note: World record 1:59:30, the first official marathon under two hours, 65 seconds inside the old record. Ran the second half in 59:01, went clear with Kejelcha after 30 km and dropped him with a mile left. He was the defending champion.

performances.name: Yomif KEJELCHA
performances.note: Second in 1:59:41 on his marathon debut: the second-fastest time in history, the fastest debut ever and an Ethiopian record. Stayed with Sawe until the final mile.

performances.name: Jacob KIPLIMO
performances.note: Third in a Ugandan record of 2:00:28, also inside the previous world record, after being dropped by the front two between 30 and 35 km.

performances.name: Amos KIPRUTO
performances.note: Fourth in a personal best of 2:01:39 after running in the lead group of six to 25 km.

performances.name: Tamirat TOLA
performances.note: The Olympic champion was fifth in a personal best of 2:02:59.

performances.name: Tigst ASSEFA
performances.note: Retained her title in 2:15:41, nine seconds inside her own women-only world record. Led a group of three through most of the race and edged clear in the closing stages.

performances.name: Hellen OBIRI
performances.note: Second in a personal best of 2:15:53 in her first London Marathon, with the leaders until the closing stages.

performances.name: Joyciline JEPKOSGEI
performances.note: Third in 2:15:55, two seconds behind Obiri, after running in the leading trio throughout.

performances.name: Catherine Reline AMANANG'OLE
performances.note: Went out with the leaders at 2:12 pace, dropped back before 15 km and faded to fifth.
